REASONING FOR BLOCK 1 (NIGHT, base price 20):

Current state: 0/10 MWh stored. I cannot discharge (no stored energy).

Optimal first move: HOLD.

Reasoning:
- Charging would make me pay the realized price for stored energy. With zero stored and assuming others do nothing, charging 1 MWh raises realized night price to 22 (base + 2×charge), meaning I'd pay ~22 per MWh. 
- Discharging is impossible with 0 stored.
- Holding avoids any payment and lets realized price settle at base (20) - but I make no profit by holding (only trading earns profit).
- Future value: tomorrow morning (50), peak (90), evening (60) have higher prices, so I want to build stored energy by night. But the first charge at night costs me real money; I'll reassess in later blocks when prices are higher and I can either charge profitably or discharge at peak.
